title: Protection & Control Engineer - BLR
jobDescription:
**Description**
  
 
  
Substation Protection & Control (Secondary) Design Engineer. Main responsibilities include creating electrical protection & control design deliverables. Projects range in size, complexity, and voltage class from small distribution equipment upgrades to large transmission projects. This position can influence the future of the resiliency, reliability, and economic operation of the electric grid.
  
 
  

  
 
  
Role and Responsibilities:
  
 
  

  
 
  
Position may include leading or executing the following assignments:
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Preparation of proposals and scope development, including conceptual designs and execution plans.
  
 
  
+ Prepare engineering cost and Man-hour estimates and schedules.
  
 
  
+ Develop detailed engineering drawings for EHV projects for AIS & GIS substations from 33kV to 765kV.
  
 
  
+ Protection and control design including panel arrangements, one lines/single lines, three lines, AC schematics, DC elementaries, equipment wiring, and relay panel wiring diagrams, cable & Conduit schedules, Bill of Materials.
  
 
  
+ Prepare calculations and reports for engineering studies (Voltage drop, AC/DC load studies & others as applicable)
  
 
  
+ Prepare equipment specifications for procurement and/or factory acceptance testing.
  
 
  
+ Coordinate design activities with other departments (Civil/Structural, Networks, Transmission Line & other as applicable).
  
 
  
+ Reviewing designs and attending virtual meetings and coordinating with Clients.
  
 
  
+ Coordinating with team members and monitoring project schedules, submitting with quality.
  
 
  
+ Produce detailed electrical substation design packages compliant with the required client technical standards or IES/IEEE/NESC.
  
 
  
+ Coordinate design activities with other Burns & McDonnell Global Practices and Office Locations.
  
 
  
+ Provide guidance and mentoring to less experienced team members.
  
 
  
+ Develop and improve processes, tools, and/or implement new technologies into the design process.
  
 
  
+ Perform quality reviews for other engineers and designers.
  
 
  
+ Demonstrate creativity, foresight, and judgment in anticipating and solving problems.
  
 
  
+ Assist with the advancement and development of department tools and workflows to increase the efficiency of designs, specification development, and project execution.
  
 
  
+ Undertake other duties and responsibilities as may be asked of this position by management.
  
 
  
+ Participate in training/meetings to address specific organizational initiatives.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Qualifications**
  
 
  
**Qualifications - External**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical from an accredited institution.
  
 
  
+ Minimum 3-6 Years of relevant experience
  
 
  

  
 
  
Skills Acquire:
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Candidate should be acquainted with NESC, IEEE standards Experience with US, Canada and UK projects is preferable.
  
 
  
+ Membership of a relevant professional Engineering Institution (e.g., IET, CIGRE, IEC, IEEE etc.) is preferable.
  
 
  
+ Strong knowledge of standard engineering techniques and procedures.
  
 
  
+ Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  
 
  
+ Ability to work methodically and analytically in a quantitative problem-solving environment and demonstrated critical thinking skills.
  
 
  
+ Proficient in standard engineering techniques and procedures.
  
 
  
+ Strong computer skills (e.g., Microsoft Office Suite)
  
 
  
+ Strong diligence, facilitation, team building, collaboration, organization, and problem-solving skills.
  
 
  
+ Basics of Substation automation system based on IEC61850.
  
 
  
+ Considered- knowledge of Relay Testing and Control / Protection scheme testing.
  
 
  
+ Considered- AutoCAD electrical & Substation 3D Design suits.
  
 
  

  
 
  
This job posting will remain open a minimum of 72 hours and on an ongoing basis until filled.

title: Network Engineer - NIA (BLR)
jobDescription:
**Description**
  
 
  
**Job Description**
  
 
  

  
 
  
The Network Engineer would be responsible for leading, and managing the team in executing the following work:
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Supporting network upgrades by replacing legacy telecommunication equipment and time division multiplexing (TDM) era technology
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Applying networking principles to assess the type of networking equipment needed on-site to support the site’s needs.  Router type, router cards, small form-factor pluggable (SFP), and power requirements will be determined utilizing site survey notes, pictures, 3D scans, and correspondence with site surveyor/design leads
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Design functions will include assessing what networking components are necessary, detailing and drafting designs, developing scope of work for installs, assembling part/equipment bill of material (BOM) requests, and supporting design discussions
  
 
  

  
 
  
·High level design and detail design for full scale complex utility grid network.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Apply telecom principals to make the network solutions offered more resilient, good usage of network protocols and protection scenarios, attentions to details, utmost care of quality of all deliverables.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Prepare configuration for MPLS, Switches, Routers, SONET etc.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Network analysis of existing grid networks and prepare cutover package solution for channel migration from TDM to packet.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Prepare Network block diagram in detail considering new installation (MPLS nodes) as per the scope, removal of old equipment, Fiber plan, channel plan, synchronization plan, circuit audits, network topology drawing, DC calculation, Panel elevation, QoS values etc.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Maintain the documentation of full project lifecycle including the design revisions, change management, preliminary, construction till as build, maintain the record of transmittal of these packages with client.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Seamless communication with cross functional project stakeholders, team, counterparts.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Ensure project milestones are met on time through effective action planning.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Qualifications**
  
 
  
**Required Skills / Experience:**
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Degree in Electrical Engineering (EE) or Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering (EXTC)
  
 
  

  
 
  
·5-8 years of experience in telecommunication engineering or network engineering.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Utility network experience would be an added advantage. Should have handled the upgradation projects for the utilities in design, testing or commissioning activity.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Hands-on experience with reputed MPLS devices.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Knowledge about implementation of QoS, Label engineering, MPLS services, PTP synchronization, circuit emulation, packet network architecture, resilient protection scenarios.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Microsoft Visio, Excel, and Word Experience
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Strong communication skills,
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Experience in Teleprotection couplers in the utility grid.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Knowledge of different IP Networking protocols for routing, switching.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Legacy Telecommunications Technology (time division multiplexing (TDM), Synchronous optical networking (SONET), serial communication)
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Network Transport Technology (Dense Wavelength Division Multiplexing (DWDM), Microwave, etc.)
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Modern Networking Technology (Multi-Protocol Label Switching (MPLS) packet networking) – MPLS-TP & MPLS-IP.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Desired Skills / Experience:**
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Technical Certification by Nokia, Cisco, or other reputable networking certification entity- would be an added advantage.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Experience, certifications, or formal education in networking, computing, or electrical engineering
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Different amplifiers in the telecom network and its integration with transport nodes.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Familiar with Firewall usage, different applications in OT networking,
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Familiarity with an electric utility’s supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) or Operational Technology (OT)
  
 
  

  
 
  
This job posting will remain open a minimum of 72 hours and on an ongoing basis until filled.

title: Senior Structural Engineer - OGC
jobDescription:
**Description**
  
**We Saved a Spot for You**
  
 
  
We welcome talented and ambitious graduates from all backgrounds who will help us shape the future of engineering and our company. At Burns & McDonnell India, you’ll have the opportunity to establish a thriving career within the Oil, Gas & Chemical (OGC) global practice. We are seeking motivated Senior Structural Engineer to join our global team delivering complex projects worldwide. Career trajectory of candidates selected to this position would be oriented towards leadership roles in project execution and/or functioning as a ‘knowledge leader’ in the CSA department leading to various leadership positions in the organization.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Responsibilities**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Executing assigned project activities with a strict focus on safety, quality, budget, and schedule KPIs.
  
 
  
+ Serving as Lead or Area Lead Engineer for small-scale projects, providing technical direction and oversight.
  
 
  
+ Developing critical project management artifacts, including project execution plans, RACI matrices, QC review matrices, work-hour estimations, and cost estimates.
  
 
  
+ Managing project controls, including scheduling, progress monitoring, change management, risk mitigation, and resource planning.
  
 
  
+ Interpreting project scope and contractual obligations to ensure full compliance across all deliverables.
  
 
  
+ Providing technical guidance, mentorship, and support to less experienced engineering personnel.
  
 
  
+ Driving intra- and inter-discipline coordination to ensure seamless execution of project tasks.
  
 
  
+ Managing battery limits, tie-ins, and complex inter-unit dependencies across engineering teams.
  
 
  
+ Maintaining high responsiveness to both internal stakeholders and external client requirements.
  
 
  
+ Performing rigorous structural calculations in accordance with international code requirements and standard industry practices.
  
 
  
+ Preparing standard discipline deliverables, including engineering calculations, 3D models, and detailed structural drawings.
  
 
  
+ Designing specialized structures, including pipe racks, technological structures, and heavy equipment foundations.
  
 
  
+ Assisting in reviewing geotechnical reports and applying data for foundation design and civil works.
  
 
  
+ Identifying and leveraging advanced design tools to optimize engineering efficiency and execution.
  
 
  
+ Reviewing engineering design inputs for adequacy, accuracy, and completeness.
  
 
  
+ Conducting thorough reviews of vendor documents and steel fabrication drawings.
  
 
  
+ Participating in formal design reviews (e.g., 3D model reviews, constructability reviews) representing the CSA department.
  
 
  
+ Resolving site queries and Requests for Information (RFIs) promptly to support construction progress.
  
 
  
+ Executing brownfield project activities, including field verification, tie-in design, laser scan data integration, and alignment with as-built documentation.
  
 
  
+ Ensuring designs are safe, of the highest quality, and deliver optimal value for the client.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Qualifications**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a Master’s degree in Structural Engineering from a reputable institution with 5 to 10 years experience in OGC project engineering
  
 
  
+ Proficiency in structural analysis and design software, specifically STAAD, RISA, and RAM; familiarity with other industry-standard software is a distinct advantage
  
 
  
+ Strong understanding of concrete and structural steel system design, including standard materials, fabrication methods, and construction practices within the Civil, Structural, and Architectural (CSA) discipline
  
 
  
+ Thorough knowledge of international industry codes and regulations, such as ACI, ASCE, AISC, and PIP
  
 
  
+ Hands-on experience interpreting laser scans for existing plants and conducting field site surveys to gather accurate engineering inputs
  
 
  
+ Solid understanding of CSA work processes, standard deliverables, project execution plans, and Project Quality Management (PQM) frameworks
  
 
  
+ Strong technical writing skills with the ability to produce clear, structured engineering documentation
  
 
  
+ Proven capability to lead a small team (approx. 5 engineers), with prior experience acting as the Lead Engineer on small-scale projects preferred
  
 
  
+ Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, with a track record of maintaining concise, regular, and timely updates
  
 
  
+ Strong interpersonal skills, including effective listening, empathy, and an appropriate level of assertiveness
  
 
  
+ Demonstrated strength in task delegation and strategic decision-making
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Why Join Us?**
  
 
  
At Burns & McDonnell India, you’ll be empowered to build not just projects, but your career. Our expansive service offerings mean stability, job security and incredible potential for growth. We take on the world’s toughest challenges and use our skills, experience, and courage to solve them.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**A Caring Place Where Careers Grow**
  
 
  
Our entrepreneurial spirit sits at the foundation of who we are as an organization and constantly drives us forward toward innovation, strategic growth, and service excellence. We believe in putting forth our ﬁnest effort, including on behalf of our employee-owners. Our beneﬁts package includes comprehensive beneﬁts that demonstrate our commitment to the well-being of the individuals who contribute to our clients’ success every day.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Work From Home (as per policy)**
  
 
  
The ability to work from home is available as per company policy, providing flexibility and work-life balance where applicable. Hybrid models may apply depending on role and department.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Flextime and Day Flextime Program**
  
 
  
Flextime allows employees to choose their own start and end times within a set range. Employees have an option to choose staggered working hours — with an option to work for six hours at the office and two hours remotely — depending on their schedule.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Bus Service**
  
 
  
We provide a dedicated company bus service for a comfortable, timely, and cost-effective commute for all employees.
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Multiple pickup points
  
 
  
+ Saves on travel costs
  
 
  
+ Provides on-time arrival
  
 
  
+ Stress-free daily travel
  
 
  

  
 
  
**On-Site Fitness Facility**
  
 
  
Each on-site ﬁtness facility provides employees with convenient access to exercise equipment and classes that support physical well-being and a healthy lifestyle.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Employee Engagement Activity**
  
 
  
From vibrant cultural celebrations like events that honor diversity and inclusion, we foster a workplace where everyone feels part of a thriving, collaborative culture. The events not only reflect our values but also build lasting memories, boost morale, and strengthen workplace bonds.
  
 
  

  
 
  
And many more...

title: IT Service Desk Engineer
jobDescription:
**Description**
  
 
  
We are seeking a skilled and customer-focused IT Service Desk Engineer to join our IT support team. The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 3 years of experience in IT support roles, with strong hands-on experience using the ServiceNow platform. This role is responsible for providing first- and second-level technical support to end-users across the organization, ensuring that service requests and incidents are resolved efficiently and effectively.
  
 
  

  
 
  
Key Responsibilities
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Serve as the initial point of contact for all IT support requests, incidents, and inquiries via phone, email, or ticketing system (ServiceNow).
  
 
  
+ Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and network issues on laptop and other peripherals.
  
 
  
+ Maintain accurate and timely updates of all assigned tickets within the ServiceNow system.
  
 
  
+ Escalate complex or unresolved issues to appropriate support teams while maintaining ownership and communication with the end user.
  
 
  
+ Perform user account management tasks including onboarding, offboarding, password resets, and permissions adjustments in Active Directory and related systems.
  
 
  
+ Ensure all service level agreements (SLAs) are met and documented appropriately.
  
 
  
+ Participate in documentation of technical processes, FAQs, and knowledge base articles.
  
 
  
+ Support IT asset management and inventory processes.
  
 
  
+ Provide remote and in-person support as needed.
  
 
  
+ Participate in on-call rotation or extended hours support, if required.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Qualifications**
  
 
  
Required
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Bachelor's degree required. Preferred in Information Technology or a related field.
  
 
  
+ Minimum of 3 years of experience in an IT Service Desk or technical support role.
  
 
  
+ Proficient in using ServiceNow for ticketing and ITSM processes.
  
 
  
+ Strong knowledge of Windows OS, Office 365, and common laptops and user applications.
  
 
  
+ Understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP).
  
 
  
+ Experience with Active Directory and basic user management tasks.
  
 
  
+ Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

title: Project Controls Engineer - ENS (Contract)
jobDescription:
**Description**
  
 
  
We are seeking a driven, analytical, and detail-oriented Project Controls Analyst to join our dedicated Project Controls team. This role is integral to our project delivery success, where you will help drive financial integrity across our project portfolio. You will be responsible for maintaining, updating, and managing project financial data, structures, and reporting within our central project portfolio management platform, EcoSys.
  
 
  

  
 
  
This is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented professional with a strong foundation in project cost concepts to master an enterprise-grade platform and support our global project teams in delivering critical infrastructure projects.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Data and Project Management in EcoSys: Create and maintain project records, Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), Cost Breakdown Structures (CBS), and internal cost codes. Ensure Work Authorization Forms (WAFs) are accurately reflected in the system.
  
 
  
+ Budgeting and Cost Control: Facilitate budget modifications, track actual expenditures, monitor commitments, and perform periodic variance analyses to provide early warnings on potential overruns and inform corrective actions.
  
 
  
+ Reporting and Analysis: Generate standard cost reports and ad-hoc analyses for project managers and clients. Translate complex financial data into actionable insights for decision-making.
  
 
  
+ Change Management: Monitor and record internal project change requests, mapping approved changes directly to active project budgets and contingency funds within EcoSys to ensure financial traceability.
  
 
  
+ System and Configuration Support: Assist senior system administrators in EcoSys setup, testing, system upgrades, and minor configuration updates to enhance system functionality and user experience.
  
**Technical & Soft Skills:**
  
 
  
+ Foundational Cost Knowledge: A firm grasp of fundamental project cost control concepts (e.g., budgets, forecasts, actuals, commitments, WBS, and Earned Value Metrics).
  
 
  
+ Software Familiarity: Prior hands-on exposure to EcoSys is highly preferred.
  
 
  
+ Familiarity with other Project Portfolio Management (PPM) or Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) tools (such as Primavera P6, Oracle Unifier, or SAP Cost Management) is beneficial.
  
 
  
+ Advanced Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, complex formulas, data analysis) are required.
  
 
  
+ Analytical Mindset: Strong logical reasoning with the ability to identify anomalies, patterns, and trends in financial datasets.
  
 
  
+ Detail-Oriented: A keen eye for data integrity, ensuring database naming conventions and budget configurations are precise and consistently applied.
  
 
  
+ Proactive Communicator: Comfortable collaborating with multi-disciplinary stakeholders, including project managers, engineers, and financial analysts, to resolve issues and provide support.

+ Experience: 1 to 3 years of experience in project controls, project cost analysis, or commercial project support, ideally within an engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) environment.

The candidate must bring strong technical accounting knowledge, leadership capability, and operational discipline to ensure accurate, timely, and high-quality financial reporting and execution. This role works closely with US corporate finance and accounting department to develop and implement strategic plans while maintaining a strong focus on execution, process improvement, and team development.
  
 
  

  
 
  
Success in this position requires a leader who can think strategically, communicate clearly and concisely, manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment, and dive into details to resolve complex issues and drive results.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Key Responsibilities**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Lead the development and execution of long-term strategic plans that support the vision and objectives of the overall team (US India).
  
 
  
+ Collaborate with US managers and the India Department Manager to establish and execute strategic plans that advance organizational goals.
  
 
  
+ Lead, mentor, and develop a team of finance professionals in India supporting US operations by setting clear expectations, driving accountability, providing coaching, and creating strong development paths that improve engagement and retention.
  
 
  
+ Foster a collaborative, high-performance work environment with strong cross-functional partnership and effective communication across US and India teams.
  
 
  
+ Provide ongoing mentoring and constructive feedback and conduct annual performance reviews for team members.
  
 
  
+ Drive innovation through automation, AI-enabled tools, digital solutions, and process standardization to improve reporting quality, efficiency, and reduce manual effort.
  
 
  
+ Identify process gaps, root causes, and inefficiencies; develop practical solutions and drive continuous improvement across workflows, procedures, and service delivery.
  
 
  
+ Partner with Human Resources on recruiting, retention, onboarding, training, and staff development.
  
 
  
+ Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure progress, drive accountability, and support continuous improvement. Prepare and present performance reports to leadership.
  
 
  
+ Represent the team in meetings and presentations with confidence and executive presence, clearly communicating team priorities, risks, and accomplishments.
  
 
  
+ Encourage continuous learning and professional development within the team.
  
 
  
+ Oversee and review the preparation and posting of journal entries and ensure timely, accurate month-end and quarter-end close activities.
  
 
  
+ Oversee and ensure timely and accurate completion of balance sheet reconciliations, while driving ownership and resolution of reconciling items.
  
 
  
+ Support strong internal controls, audit readiness, and compliance with financial reporting requirements, company policies, and regulatory standards.
  
 
  
+ Oversee the treasury team’s execution of functions assigned by the US treasury team, including corporate credit card administration and reporting.
  
 
  
+ Oversee the taxation team’s completion of tasks assigned by the US taxation team, including support for international, state, and local tax returns for US and international entities.
  
 
  
+ Apply sound business judgment, creativity, and foresight to anticipate issues, remove obstacles, and solve problems proactively.
  
 
  
+ Balance strategic leadership with a willingness to dive into details, understand root causes, and resolve complex financial and operational issues when needed.
  
 
  
+ Occasional travel to the US may be required.
  
 
  
+ Perform additional responsibilities as assigned.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Qualifications**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Chartered Accountant (CA), CPA, or MBA from premier institutions strongly preferred.
  
 
  
+ Minimum 9 - 12 years of relevant experience, including supervisory or management roles.
  
 
  
+ Strong technical accounting knowledge, with experience in financial reporting, close processes, reconciliations, and understanding of US GAAP principles strongly preferred.
  
 
  
+ Proven leadership skills with the ability to build, develop, motivate, and retain high-performing teams.
  
 
  
+ Strong coach and people manager who sets clear expectations, drives accountability, and develops talent effectively.
  
 
  
+ Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment while maintaining high standards of accuracy and execution.
  
 
  
+ Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with sound business judgment and decision-making ability.
  
 
  
+ Ability to think strategically while also diving into details to understand issues and drive effective resolution.
  
 
  
+ Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate clearly, concisely, and effectively across all levels of the organization, including senior leadership and US business partners.

title: Senior Technology Solutions Specialist (OGC)
jobDescription:
**Description**
  
 
  
**About the Role**
  
 
  
The oil, gas and chemical sector is undergoing a profound and accelerating transformation. To maintain a competitive edge in an increasingly dynamic market, our organization is embracing digitalization and automation to enhance operational efficiency, improve safety standards, and drive long-term sustainability goals. This role is not merely about writing code or managing systems — it is about fundamentally reshaping how we operate. You will stand at the forefront of this transformation, harnessing cutting-edge technology to solve complex challenges: from optimizing production workflows and predicting maintenance needs, to ensuring the security and resilience of our critical infrastructure.
  
 
  

  
 
  
We are seeking a highly motivated, innovative, and results-driven Senior Technology Solution Specialist to join our technology team. In this pivotal role, you will design, develop, and deploy software solutions that power our digital initiatives — playing a crucial part in building, implementing, and maintaining technologies that elevate our engineering processes to new heights.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Key Responsibilities :**
  
 
  
**1. Software Development & Solution Architecture**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Design, develop, and deploy scalable full-stack software applications supporting digital transformation initiatives across the oil, gas and chemical value chain.

+ Build robust APIs, microservices, and data pipelines using Python and modern development frameworks.
  
 
  
+ Evaluate and recommend emerging technologies, tools, and frameworks to improve solution quality and delivery speed.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**2. Data Engineering & Analytics Platforms**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Develop and manage data solutions on Microsoft Databricks and Data verse, including data ingestion, transformation, modelling, and analytics workflows.
  
 
  
+ Build and maintain data pipelines that enable real-time monitoring, predictive maintenance models, and production optimization dashboards.
  
 
  
+ Ensure data quality, governance, and security across all digital platforms and data assets.
  
 
  
+ Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to productionize machine learning models and analytical tools.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**3. Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps**

+ Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated testing frameworks, and DevOps practices to accelerate delivery.
  
 
  
+ Monitor system health, performance, and security; proactively identify and resolve issues to ensure operational continuity.
  
 
  
+ Manage infrastructure-as-code, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud-native architectures.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**4. Collaboration Platforms & Knowledge Management**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Design, configure, and manage Microsoft SharePoint solutions for document management, team collaboration, and internal portals.
  
 
  
+ Develop automation workflows and integrations between SharePoint, Teams, and other enterprise systems to streamline operations.
  
 
  
+ Champion digital workspace best practices and drive user adoption of collaboration tools across the organization.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**5. Agile Delivery & Project Management**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Act as Scrum Master for agile delivery teams, facilitating sprint ceremonies, managing backlogs, and removing impediments to ensure consistent delivery.
  
 
  
+ Manage project workflows using Jira and Confluence — maintaining transparency, tracking progress, and providing stakeholder reporting.
  
 
  
+ Mentor team members on agile methodologies, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and iterative delivery.
  
 
  
+ Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders including engineers, operations, HSE, and business leaders to align technology solutions with organizational objectives.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**6. Innovation & Continuous Improvement**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Proactively identify opportunities to apply digital technologies — including IoT, AI/ML, automation, and advanced analytics — to enhance safety, efficiency, and sustainability.
  
 
  
+ Lead proof-of-concept initiatives and technology pilots, translating business challenges into scalable digital solutions.
  
 
  
+ Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and regulatory requirements relevant to the oil, gas and chemical sector.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Required Technical Skills**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ The ideal candidate should possess strong technical expertise in Full Stack Development, Python, Microsoft Databricks & Data verse, Azure Deployment, GCP & DevOps, Microsoft SharePoint, Agile/Scrum methodologies, Jira & Confluence, and CI/CD Pipelines.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**1. Full Stack Development**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Proficiency in front-end technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
  
 
  
+ Strong back-end development experience with RESTful APIs, Node.js, .NET, or similar server-side technologies.
  
 
  
+ Experience with relational and NoSQL databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cosmos DB).
  
 
  

  
 
  
**2. Python**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Advanced Python programming skills for application development, data engineering, automation, and scripting.
  
 
  
+ Experience with Python libraries for data processing and analytics (Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, SQLAlchemy).
  
 
  

  
 
  
**3. Microsoft Databricks & Data verse**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Hands-on experience building and managing Databricks workspaces, Delta Lake, and Spark-based data pipelines.
  
 
  
+ Working knowledge of Microsoft Data verse for data modelling, integration, and Power Platform solutions.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**4. Azure Deployment**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Proven ability to architect, deploy, and manage cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure (App Services, ADF, Azure Functions, AKS, Azure DevOps).
  
 
  
+ Experience with Azure security, identity management (AAD), networking, and monitoring tools.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**5. GCP & DevOps**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform services (BigQuery, Cloud Run, GKE, Pub/Sub).
  
 
  
+ Strong DevOps practices: CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and version control with Git.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**6. Microsoft SharePoint**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Experience designing and configuring SharePoint Online sites, libraries, lists, and workflows.
  
 
  
+ Ability to develop custom SharePoint solutions and Power Automate integrations.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**7. Agile Project Management — Scrum Master**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Certified Scrum Master (CSM or equivalent) with practical experience leading agile ceremonies in cross-functional teams.
  
 
  
+ Proficient in Jira for sprint management, backlog grooming, and reporting; Confluence for documentation and knowledge management.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Qualifications**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  
 
  
+ 6 to 10 years of progressive experience in software development and IT, with demonstrated leadership on complex technology projects.
  
 
  
+ Experience within the oil, gas, chemical, or broader energy and industrial sectors is highly desirable.
  
 
  
+ Strong understanding of OT/IT convergence, industrial IoT, and digital twin concepts is a plus.
  
 
  
+ Relevant certifications (Azure, GCP, Databricks, Scrum Master) are advantageous.
  
 
  
+ Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
  
 
  
+ A self-starter with strong analytical thinking, problem-solving capability, and a passion for technology-driven innovation.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**What We Offer**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ A high-impact role at the center of the digital transformation of a critical global industry.
  
 
  
+ Opportunity to work with advanced technology stacks across cloud, data, and automation domains.
  
 
  
+ Collaborative and inclusive work culture that values innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Why Join Us**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ This role places you at the intersection of engineering and technology on real projects that affect safety, schedules and long term assets. You will work with colleagues across India and the United States, see how design decisions turn into built facilities and shape tools that help people do some of the most complex work in our industry.
  
 
  
+ Burns & McDonnell is an employee owned company, and many people build entire careers here because of the stability, long term horizon and shared ownership culture. The company is known for investing in its people through training, mentoring and opportunities to take on larger responsibilities over time.
  
 
  
+ In this role you will have room to experiment with modern cloud tools, AI and automation, while staying grounded in the day to day needs of engineers and designers. For the right person, this is a chance to grow into a trusted partner for project leaders and a key voice in how digital work evolves in the OGC practice.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Reporting Relationships**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ The Technology Solutions Specialist reports directly to the Technology and Innovation Manager. The role also maintains strong functional working relationships with the GP Manager, Engineering Manager, Department Managers and other Design Application Specialists. Day to day work planning will be coordinated with the Technology and Innovation Manager, with input from Engineering leadership on priority workflows and pilots.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Future Roadmap**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ This role offers a unique opportunity to grow into a technology leader within our organization. In the first year, you will focus on mastering our existing systems and delivering key software projects. Following that, you will have the opportunity to lead new initiatives, mentor junior team members and specialize in areas such as artificial intelligence, cybersecurity or enterprise architecture. We are committed to your professional development and will provide you with the resources and support needed to stay at the forefront of technology and advance your career.

title: Power Market Engineer (Bengaluru)
jobDescription:
**Description**
  
 
  
The Resource Planning and Market Assessment (RP&MA) team is responsible for economic analysis of various electric utilities across the US, with a focus on integrating renewables and storage to plan for the clean energy grid of the future. We advise our development team, company leadership, and external clients on optimal resource planning decisions. We contribute to investment decisions in solar, wind, battery storage and hydrogen. We are a data-driven team that believes in continuous improvement and collaboration. This means that we are always looking to develop better tools, processes, and modeling approaches through learning and knowledge sharing. We are looking for someone who enjoys challenges, works well in a collaborative team environment, and revels in seeking answers through data analytics. The Engineer of RP&MA Planning is part of a highly skilled professional team and reports to the Manager of the department.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Responsibilities :**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Perform a broad range of studies and other consulting services to support electric utilities and asset developers to make decisions backed by business and engineering analysis regarding their investments and power supply requirements, such as integrated resource planning, market assessments, valuations, and power supply RFP evaluations.
  
 
  
+ Researching about the US power markets (PJM, MISO, NEISO, SPP, CAISO, WECC, SERC, ERCOT, NYISO) and assisting for the production cost & capacity expansion models development which can be utilized for the power price forecasting and congestion & curtailment risk evaluation.
  
 
  
+ Perform forecasts and evaluations utilizing power supply planning software such as capacity optimization and hourly dispatch software models.
  
 
  
+ Extracting key operational characteristics and market assumptions from internal sources and third-party databases like S&P Global and Velocity Suite.
  
 
  
+ Analyze life-cycle costs by developing and incorporating technical assumptions regarding capital costs, operation and maintenance costs, performance estimates, and economic assumptions and forecasts.
  
 
  
+ Conduct technical and business-related risk assessments that evaluate impacts associated with rules implemented by regulatory agencies.
  
 
  
+ Developing presentation materials that communicate clearly the analyses performed and conveying insights that help developers better serve their utility customers.
  
 
  
+ Support multiple ad hoc projects inclusive of those above, completing them in a timely manner.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Qualifications**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Master's degree in Power / Energy systems is preferred or bachelor’s in electrical engineering is must.
  
 
  
+ Prior experience associated with electric utility operations, planning, or consulting is preferred.
  
 
  
+ 2-3 years of experience in production cost modeling, and/or power market economics analysis using industry-standard models such as PROMOD or PLEXOS.

+ Sophisticated data management and statistical analysis skills using Excel VBA, Power BI, R and Python

jobDescription:
**Description** Burns & McDonnell (BMI) is seeking a driven Water Resources / Hydraulics & Hydrologic Engineer to join our Environmental (ENS) Division in support of a wide variety of US-based projects. The ENS team supports engineering design and study efforts that include stormwater management systems, drainage and conveyance infrastructure, flood control evaluations, remediation sites, solid waste and resource recovery facilities, water/wastewater systems, utilities, and other infrastructure projects.
  
 
  

  
 
  
This role will focus on hydrologic and hydraulic analyses, flood studies, stormwater and drainage design, and environmental infrastructure support, with particular emphasis on hydraulic modeling using HEC-RAS, including 2D applications.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Responsibilities:**
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Develop and apply hydrologic and hydraulic models for flood studies, stormwater systems, drainage evaluations, and related environmental infrastructure projects.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Support water resource planning studies, event-based hydrologic analyses, watershed evaluations, and floodplain assessments.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Perform hydraulic analyses using HEC-RAS, including 1D and, where applicable, 2D modeling approaches, to support design studies and project development.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Support watershed and runoff evaluations using tools such as HEC-HMS and other hydrologic modeling platforms.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Assist with statistical and risk-based hydrologic evaluations using HEC-SSP or similar tools, as applicable.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Use HEC-HMS and HEC-RAS to evaluate flood depth, flow routing, channel behavior, and other system responses.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Use ESRI ArcGIS to map watershed boundaries, land use/land cover, soil classifications, LiDAR surfaces, hydraulic structures, and other spatial datasets.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Incorporate site-specific topography, geotechnical data, survey information, and existing infrastructure into hydrologic and hydraulic models.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Support engineering calculations related to pipeline hydraulics, pump system behavior, stormwater conveyance, basin sizing, and grading/drainage analysis.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Coordinate modeling results with civil, structural, mechanical, and process engineering teams to support design evaluations and optimize project solutions.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Assist in preparing plans, specifications, reports, and technical documentation for stormwater projects.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Maintain modeling datasets, follow established workflows, and perform quality checks to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Collaborate with US-based project managers and engineers to support project delivery and meet schedule and quality expectations.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Qualifications**
  
 
  
·Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Water Resources Engineering, or a related discipline from a recognized institution.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Minimum 4 – 8 years of experience in water resources, hydrology/hydraulics, stormwater, drainage, or related civil engineering work.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Working knowledge of US codes and standards.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Strong experience with hydraulic modeling using HEC-RAS is required, experience with HEC-RAS 2D and HEC-HMS is preferred.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Proficient in ESRI ArcGIS and Microsoft Office Tools (Excel, Word, Outlook, Powerpoint, OneNote) is required.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Experience with HEC-SSP, AutoCAD Civil 3D, StormCAD and/or CivilStorm is a plus.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Strong attention to detail, facilitation, team building, collaboration, organization and problem-solving skills.
  
 
  

  
 
  
·Excellent communication skills in English (verbal & written).

jobDescription:
**Description**
  
 
  
As a Power System Planning Engineer, you will be a key member of our Power Systems Energy & Utility Consulting- Transmission Planning team, contributing significantly to the growth of transmission and distribution activities. You will be responsible for developing and performing comprehensive power system studies and models for energy clients worldwide, covering aspects of power generation (both conventional and non-conventional), transmission, distribution, and industrial systems. This role will require the application of advanced engineering techniques to solve complex problems in the transmission and distribution sectors.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Responsibilities:**
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Power System Analysis & Modelling**
  
 
  
- Perform advanced technical modeling and simulation of electrical power systems, including power flow studies, transient stability, dynamic studies, reactive compensation, and contingency analysis.
  
 
  
- Utilize power system analysis tools like PSS/E, ASPEN, PSLF, TARA, and MiPower to carry out studies.
  
 
  
- Conduct steady state, short circuit studies, reliability studies, contingency analysis, and protection coordination studies to enhance the performance and reliability of electrical networks.
  
 
  
- Conduct Interconnection Application Study
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Technical Leadership**
  
 
  
- Lead and execute power system planning and analysis projects, ensuring that deadlines and quality standards are met.
  
 
  
- Provide technical direction to other team members, including training and development of junior engineers.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Data & Process Automation**
  
 
  
- Develop and implement automation tools using Python and other software to streamline repetitive tasks involved in power system analysis and reporting.
  
 
  
- Continuously improve modeling and data analysis processes by integrating new techniques and tools.

- Act as a point of contact for clients, engaging them to understand their technical requirements and ensuring effective delivery of solutions.
  
 
  
- Provide clear and effective communication, presentations, and reports to clients and internal stakeholders, explaining complex technical concepts in an understandable manner.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Compliance & Standards**
  
 
  
- Ensure all projects are compliant with relevant IEEE/NERC, IEC, and other international standards.
  
 
  
- Remain updated on industry developments and standards, with a focus on North American power systems (if relevant), to bring best practices into project execution.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Project Management**
  
 
  
- Oversee projects concurrently, ensuring the identification and resolution of critical path items to meet client deadlines.
  
 
  
- Coordinate with project managers and team members to ensure deliverables are aligned with client needs and expectations.
  
 
  
- Prepare project documentation, including reports, technical specifications, and procedures, to support ongoing and future projects.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Innovation & Continuous Improvement**
  
 
  
- Stay updated with the latest technologies, trends, research, paper, policies and innovations in the energy and power systems sector.
  
 
  
- Contribute to the continuous improvement of internal processes, including the development of new methodologies and tools for power system planning.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**International Collaboration & Travel**
  
 
  
- Collaborate with international teams and clients, with the flexibility to work across multiple time zones.
  
 
  
- Be prepared to travel internationally to meet with clients, attend conferences, and support global projects as necessary.
  
 
  

  
 
  
**Qualifications**
  
 
  

  
 
  
+ Master’s in electrical engineering or Bachelor’s in electrical engineering with 3-7years of experience; advanced degree preferred.
  
 
  
+ 7-10 years of relevant professional experience.
  
 
  
+ Excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively interact with diverse stakeholders and present complex technical information clearly and concisely.
  
 
  
+ Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  
 
  
+ Flexible approach to work, and ability to prioritize and manage time effectively to meet deadlines and client needs.
  
 
  
+ Proficiency in a few planning software such as PSS/E, PSLF,PSCAD, DigSILENT, and MiPower.
  
 
  
+ Experience with transmission power system planning and operations: load forecasting, generator interconnection, and harmonics analysis, Power flow studies, short circuit, transient stability, dynamic Studies, contingency analysis, reliability studies, risk assessment techniques, and protection coordination studies; generator interconnection; load forecasting and harmonics analysis.
  
 
  
+ Proven track record of leading teams and providing guidance as and when required
  
 
  
+ Stay up to date with latest industry trends and technologies and share information with others
  
 
  
+ Ability to lead technical execution of projects from inception through completion

Designs include the electrical interconnect to the bulk power grid and all associated power generating facility auxiliary power equipment. Equipment includes rotating machines, such as generators and motors, large power transformers, generator circuit breakers, isolated phase bus duct, non-segregated phase bus duct, switchgear, motor control centers, small power transformers, and variable frequency drives.
